claim: 2025 MICHELIN Guide Vietnam awarded 9 one-star restaurants across Hanoi, HCMC, and Da Nang; HCMC has 5 one-star restaurants including 2 new recipients CieL and Coco Dining
quote: The 2025 MICHELIN Guide Hanoi | Ho Chi Minh City | Da Nang Celebrates Vietnam's Culinary Ascent with 9 One Star, 2 Green Star, and 63 Bib Gourmand

claim: HCMC has 5 one-star restaurants: Akuna (2024-2025), Anan Saigon (2023-2025), Long Trieu (2024-2025), CieL (2025), Coco Dining (2025)
quote: Vietnam's inaugural Michelin Guide launched in 2023, covering Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City

claim: Ănăn Saigon serves dinner only Tue-Sun from 5PM; Saigon Tasting Menu US$100 food-only, Chef's Menu US$145; book 2 weeks ahead via hello@anansaigon.com
quote: Saigon Tasting Menu: US$100 (food only); Chef Peter's Tasting Menu: US$145 (food only)

claim: Long Trieu serves lunch 11:00-14:00 and dinner 18:00-22:00; set menus from VND 2,180,000++ per person; 50+ dim sum options; booking at +84 28 3823 6688
quote: Special Menu: From VND 2,180,000++/person; Bird's Nest Set Menu: VND 3,888,000++/person

claim: Akuna is led by Chef Sam Aisbett on the 9th floor of Le Méridien Saigon; open Tue-Sat 6PM-10PM; named 'flowing water' in Aboriginal language
quote: Vietnamese cuisine focused on 'the culinary possibilities amidst the beautiful chaos of Saigon'

claim: CieL is open Tue-Sun 5:30PM-11PM (service 6:30PM, last seating 8:30PM); located at 50 Street 6/3, Thao Dien Ward, Thu Duc City; reservations at +84 903 600 505 or info@cieldining.com
quote: Tuesday to Sunday, 5:30pm–11pm (service begins 6:30pm; last seating 8:30pm)

claim: Coco Dining is located at 143 Nam Ky Khoi Nghia, District 3; open daily 5:30PM-11PM; reservations via inquiry@cocosgn.com; 'Lữ Hành' tasting menu explores Vietnamese culinary identity
quote: The 'Lữ Hành' tasting menu represents 'an emotional exploration of memory, movement, and Vietnamese culinary identity'

claim: Akuna open Tue-Sat from 6PM (last seating 8:30PM) at 3C Ton Duc Thang, District 1; CieL chef Viet Hong trained at Noma, Disfrutar, Sézanne before returning to Vietnam in 2023
quote: Chef Viet Hong trained at world-renowned kitchens including Noma, Disfrutar, and Sézanne

claim: CieL offers a 10-course tasting menu for $120++ per person; signature dish is fish maw with egg custard; restaurant seats 15 guests in Scandinavian minimalist villa in Thao Dien
quote: The full tasting menu costs $120++ per person and features 10 courses. A special kids' menu is available for $75++.

claim: CieL opened September 2024 and earned a Michelin star just 7 months later in the 2025 Guide; Chef Le Viet Hong born 1992 also won the Michelin Young Chef Award
quote: Chef Le Viet Hong, born in 1992, trained at Michelin three-star establishments including Noma, Sezanne, and Disfrutar before returning to Vietnam in 2023

claim: Akuna rated 4.0/5 on TripAdvisor (22 reviews); 6-course tasting menu approx VND 3.9M (~$165); chandelier of 1,200 handcrafted glass tubes over the open kitchen; Saigon River views
quote: An 'elegant open kitchen' features a chandelier handcrafted from 1,200 glass tubes. The restaurant overlooks the Saigon River

claim: Coco Dining rated 4.6/5 on TripAdvisor (93 reviews); part of CoCo Saigon complex with whisky bar and private villa; cuisine praised as 'creative and authentic Vietnamese flavors'
quote: Food praised as 'creative and authentic Vietnamese flavors' with 'beautiful imaginative' presentation; Service noted as 'attentive' and 'impeccable'

claim: Ănăn Saigon's 10-course Chef's Tasting Menu costs ~$135++; signature dishes include foie gras spring roll with truffle, Le Petit Bánh Mì, and Fish Sauce Ice Cream with 'Nuoc Mam Perfume'
quote: Foie gras spring roll with truffle and mango; Le petit banh mi with wagyu beef; Fish sauce ice cream with 'NUOC MAM PERFUME'

claim: Long Trieu is at 4F, The Reverie Saigon, 22-36 Nguyen Hue Boulevard, District 1; Cantonese chef Wong Fu Keung; signature dishes include abalone, Peking duck, honey-grilled ribs
quote: Chef Wong Fu Keung; set menu pricing starts around VND 3.68 million per person

claim: Long Trieu situated inside The Reverie Saigon hotel with jade stonework, gold-leaf painted Chinese scenes, and 9 private rooms; one Michelin star held since 2024
quote: The lavish dining room boasts jade stonework, traditional gold-leaf painted Chinese scenes and ornate seating

claim: Chef Sam Aisbett previously held two Michelin stars in Australia before bringing his Modern Australian-Japanese-Vietnamese cuisine to Saigon at Akuna
quote: Celebrated Chef Sam Aisbett, presents Akuna at the Le Méridien Saigon
